reviews.text: I took my Spitz to Au Luxe Canin for the first time and I was very happy with the result! They took great care of my dog ​​and took the time to look after her properly. I will definitely go back and I recommend them 100%!! 😊

So friendly, welcoming and did such an amazing job for our cavapoo! 🐶 she’s only a puppy so can be very nervous but they were so lovely with her. Really made us feel at ease! Her fur is absolutely beautiful and soft after they were finished, will definitely be back 😊 …

Last week…

I dropped off my twin Cavalier King Charles Spaniels at Luxe Canin, having already received excellent recommendations. A few hours later, I found my two little treasures happy, proud, and so beautifully groomed by Aude and her assistant that words fail me.

I simply had to share this experience with you because if, like me, your dog deserves the very best and you're just waiting for a reassuring review, then this is mine.

6/5. Without hesitation.

Absolutely perfect for my two little ones!

I highly recommend it.

My dog ​​has been getting groomed since she was a puppy, and I've tried countless groomers, but I've never been so satisfied! She's very timid, especially with groomers, and she has a real fear of water, so each appointment is usually quite stressful for both of us.

This is the first time I've felt so reassured leaving her. The groomer was incredibly gentle, patient, and kind. You can really tell she takes the time to put the dog at ease and that she cares for her with great attention.

I picked up my dog ​​perfectly groomed, all clean, and most importantly, calm, which is very rare after a grooming session. It's such a pleasure to finally find someone I can trust completely.

A huge thank you to the groomer for her professionalism and kindness ❤️ I really recommend this place 100%, especially if you have a fearful or difficult dog with grooming!

I'm so happy with my 3-year-old Cavalier King Charles' grooming! 🐶🤍

For the first time in almost three years since we got her, she hasn't had any tangles at all since her visit to the groomer! She'd been groomed by another groomer since she was a puppy, about every six weeks.

Her coat is magnificent: all the dead hair was removed, and the result is truly incredible. ✨

The groomer also took the time to express her anal glands, which is a real bonus.

You can tell she knows her stuff and really cares about dogs. I'm thrilled to have finally found a groomer I trust for Vega! 🥰

I highly recommend her!

5 stars! Aude and her team were absolutely exceptional from start to finish – they were as reassuring for our dog as they were for us during this first grooming experience! Top-notch ++++: welcome, service, advice, care, and 5-star results. I have already highly recommended Aude's services to friends and will be booking the next grooming appointment very soon!! Thank you Aude & Team!!

A huge thank you! ❤️ This is by far the best grooming salon I've ever been to in Paris.

You can immediately feel how much the animals are loved and respected here. My little dog is always greeted with such gentleness, attention, and kindness, and I can leave him with complete confidence.

I always go to this groomer and wouldn't go anywhere else. The results are always magnificent, but above all, the dogs' well-being is truly the priority.

I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for excellent grooming in the 16th arrondissement. For me, it's simply the best place for our furry friends. 🐶❤️
Great place ! My dog came back beautiful and very happy

If you want a beautiful, smelling, and well-groomed dog, head straight to Au Luxe Canin. Your dog will leave looking like they've never been groomed in any other salon. You can really see the difference; it's a thorough, simply perfect job.

First time for my dog ​​this week, and I found the perfect salon. You can tell they're passionate about their work and love animals!
I'll definitely be back!
Perfect, great service!
A fantastic experience with serious women who truly love dogs. My dog ​​now has a better coat than me!

A wonderful person, very professional and kind!

I highly recommend her ❤️

It's such a joy to see our beautiful and happy little Snoopy again!

Aude is a skilled professional, gentle and precise.
Thank you so much and see you very soon!

After trying several groomers, I've finally found the perfect one! My dog ​​has never looked so beautiful and been so well-groomed. Aude does truly exceptional work; you can immediately see her professionalism and the care she puts into every detail.

In addition to being very kind, you can tell she genuinely loves animals, and that makes all the difference. My dog ​​came out looking gorgeous and feeling serene.
It's so nice to have finally found a trustworthy place. I recommend her without hesitation!

A huge thank you to Aude for her incredible work with my poodle, Chuck! He arrived in a terrible state after a very bad grooming session, with knots everywhere, and she did an absolutely remarkable job.

Aude was incredibly gentle and professional. Chuck is usually quite difficult and suffers from separation anxiety, but he immediately felt comfortable with her. It was a real joy to see how well she took care of him.

The result is simply magnificent: he's never looked so good! I wholeheartedly recommend Aude to anyone looking for a caring, patient, and extremely talented groomer. Thank you again!
Absolutely fantastic! My dog ​​looked amazing. The groomer was so kind and caring: superb 👍. I highly recommend her! …

Very nicely ce reception and perfect toillettage
Nice aftercare

You will be welcomed by a lovely person.
You can leave your little companion with complete peace of mind. The one you love so much and who shares our lives.
They will be groomed with kindness and gentleness. 😊 Thank you so much for the work done on my little Spitz.
It's a specific product that was recommended. It's great for the coat in the long run.

Thank you, Aude, for your professionalism.
You provided excellent care for my dog.
See you soon! 🤗 …

I left my golden retriever in for grooming.
Everything went perfectly. I received several excellent tips, and the service was of very high quality.
I highly recommend Luxe Canin.
My dog's first grooming session was perfect! The groomer was patient, attentive, and took the time to explain things. I highly recommend her!

Thank you, Aude! Thank you for the warm and genuine welcome! It's so appreciated. Valdo's service was also straightforward and no-nonsense 😊 (which is reassuring), and a huge thank you for the work done, as it's exactly what I wanted. I was a little disappointed by my first experience at another salon, but now I know where to go 😊 I'm adding another 🌟 to my review. Thanks again, Aude, and see you soon! ✌️

Serious and meticulous work on Vegas, which has never looked so good.
Thank you and see you soon.
Wonderful Aude who made my little dog look so beautiful. A true professional
Aude offers a complete and high-quality service; I highly recommend her salon, by far the best experience my two little ones have had so far.

Aïko was groomed here, and I am absolutely delighted. The result is impeccable; my dog ​​came out looking magnificent with a soft, well-groomed coat, perfectly suited to his breed.

You can immediately tell that Aude is passionate, gentle, and very attentive to the well-being of animals. She takes her time, gives excellent advice, and is very knowledgeable about the specific needs of dogs like Spitz.

Aïko felt completely at ease despite his young age, and everything went very smoothly.

I highly recommend her; she offers true professionalism with great kindness. Thank you again for everything!

A huge thank you to Aude, who always takes such good care of my little Ruby with such gentleness and professionalism. ✨ After a misstep that led to a bad experience at another salon, her fur was damaged, rough, and difficult to repair… but thanks to her expertise and skills, she managed to restore her coat. A month later, it's still soft. 🐶💛 The result is always impeccable: my dog ​​comes out looking beautiful and well-groomed. Besides being lovely, you can tell she truly loves animals and works with passion. I trust her completely and recommend her 100%! 👏
Thank you so much for your kindness and expertise in grooming! First time and definitely not the last!!! I highly recommend them.

Excellent, thorough work. We were impressed by Aude's professionalism; she's passionate about her work and takes the time needed for each dog. She has an excellent understanding of dogs. Our dachshund looks fantastic every time.
If you find an opening, take it!

Kindness, care, and professionalism are the hallmarks of LUXE CANIN.

We've established a ritual for our Continental Bulldog: a monthly session, and our dog loves it 😘
Share and go without hesitation 👍
I want to say that she is an exceptional groomer, very professional and wonderful with my dog. I highly recommend her.

Thank you to Aude for her professionalism and kindness. I've never been so satisfied.
See you soon for another appointment.

Very professional, very clean, and attentive... she was kind to my little Mimi and very concerned about the well-being of the animals she cares for. Thank you again, and Mimi will come back to you with great pleasure! 🐾 …
Excellent grooming for my first visit with my Havanese, very welcoming staff
Super friendly and very professional!

Very happy with my Shih Tzu's grooming 🐶✨
The team is gentle and professional, and my dog ​​came out looking beautiful and relaxed.
I highly recommend them! …
Very professional, I highly recommend them!!!!
The best place for a Spitz! Fantastic welcome, you can really feel their love for dogs. The work is always superb, I love the proud look on my dog's face when he leaves!
It's incredibly difficult to get an appointment...
Thank you Aude for your consistently professional work and top-notch grooming. I wish you a smooth delivery and see you very soon. Kisses.

Update to my previous review:

While our initial experience was wonderful, I feel it’s important to share a more complete picture after a recent visit. Unfortunately, I was given unsolicited advice regarding my dog’s behavior, which I found intrusive and inappropriate. I hadn’t asked for training tips, and being told how to handle my own dog—especially in a situation where he was clearly just feeling insecure in an unfamiliar environment—crossed a boundary for me.

It’s disappointing to have to justify my dog’s natural reaction or explain his behavior at all. He’s a well-adjusted dog who simply felt uneasy when left alone in a new space—something that doesn’t need analyzing or correction from someone who doesn’t know him.

Kindness also means knowing when to hold back advice.

___
We are beyond happy with our experience at this dog salon! From the very first moment, our dog was welcomed with so much love and care—it’s rare to find someone who treats animals this gently and respectfully. The result was absolutely perfect: our dog looks beautiful, feels great, and was clearly comfortable the whole time.

We’ve tried other places in Paris before, but none even come close to this level of attention, warmth, and professionalism. You can truly feel the passion and heart behind everything she does.

A truly wonderful person with a magical touch for dogs. We’re incredibly grateful and won’t go anywhere else. Highly, highly recommended!

A wonderful place where you feel right at home.
Everything is top-notch, from start to finish.
They clearly put just as much effort into caring for the dogs as they do into caring for their owners, and that's truly heartwarming!
Thank you for everything 🙏

First grooming session for my 10-month-old son. I was apprehensive, but Aude instinctively reassured me. She made Ragnar look absolutely stunning, and I'm so glad I entrusted my puppy to you.
She is a woman of rare professionalism who takes the time to explain each step of the grooming process, the products she uses on your pet, and why. You can truly tell that she loves what she does and finds meaning in her profession.
Thank you again for your warm welcome and the wonderful service you provided my baby. He's just too cute. We will definitely be back!

I've been entrusting my Spitz to Aude for almost three years now, and he always comes out looking incredibly clean and handsome!

She takes care of him with gentleness, patience, and kindness; I feel completely at ease leaving him in her hands. Thank you to her for her kindness and support.
You can have 100% confidence in Aude and her salon, Au Luxe Canin!
Lovely owner, beautiful haircut.  Stella looks fantastic - It was worth every minute of the trip from the 19th arrondissement! Wish I could find a groomer like Au Luxe Canin in Connecticut!
I really liked the Salon.  Aude is extremely professional and has a top notch spa for our fur babies.  Plan to go back!!
A thousand thanks again to Aude for her great professionalism and kindness. My little Jack Russell left the salon transformed 🤩 …

A luxurious grooming experience for our little Milly!

Our 14-month-old Australian Shepherd received an exceptional grooming session at Au Luxe.

From our very first phone call, Aude put us at ease with her personalized service and attentive listening. She was just as attentive and caring during our follow-up conversations after the grooming.

Milly was thrilled, looking even more beautiful than ever after her session! I searched for a long time for a trustworthy groomer, and even though it means a 40-minute walk, we will remain loyal to Aude to take care of our Milly.
Thank you for your kindness, warm welcome, and advice. You gave my little Nila a fantastic grooming session. Here's my little darling at her hairdresser's! 😍 …
I highly recommend her; I entrust my Pomeranian to her with complete confidence and am always satisfied with the results! She is very professional and attentive to the smallest details.

I highly recommend Au Luxe Canin. Their professionalism and attention to detail are impeccable, and the care given to my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel demonstrates a genuine love for animals. I highly recommend them to all dog owners looking for a top-of-the-range grooming service. Thank you!

Aude knew how to calm and relax my Chihuahua, who immediately appreciated her kindness and gentleness… he left looking wonderful, with treatments to address his skin problem.

I highly recommend this salon where Aude welcomes you with a smile and her cheerful disposition!
Thank you.

A truly passionate, kind, and competent person. Aude does a fantastic job.
Go for it without hesitation!
Very satisfied! My Pomeranian came out looking great with a perfect haircut. Excellent service, I highly recommend!

This is by far the best grooming salon in the Paris region. Oreo loves coming to be pampered at Luxe Canin and leaves with a magnificent cut and coat. Thank you for taking care of our furry friends the way you do: with love and professionalism.

I highly recommend it, it's a fantastic place.
Patient and gentle with animals, you won't be disappointed.

And of course, I got my little one back all clean and smelling wonderful. Don't hesitate, go for it!

A huge thank you for the excellent grooming! My Spitz was treated with professionalism and care. The cut is perfectly suited to her needs, and she's much more comfortable now. Aude is a true specialist in the breed; I highly recommend her.

Thank you so much, Aude, for your excellent work, your professionalism, your expertise, and your patience 🙂
I highly recommend you. …
Excellent service, friendly staff, I highly recommend them, thank you Aude!
"An exceptional experience at Au Lux Canin! The staff is professional and attentive, and my dog ​​left beautifully groomed and happy. A quality service that I highly recommend to all dog owners."

An impeccable experience, I'm so happy with the result! I took my Pomeranian puppy for his first grooming session and he was thrilled too! It's a pleasure to work with a professional who is so passionate about what she does. I highly recommend her; you can leave your little one with her with complete confidence!

Best groomer in Paris!
Shiro has never looked so good.
I highly recommend her!
Very happy with the result for my Coton de Tuléar. The groomer is remarkably professional. I recommend her 100%.

An excellent professional, gentle and caring with dogs. My little poodle, Princess, always looks impeccable when we leave, perfectly groomed, and above all, relaxed and happy. You can feel a genuine love for animals and a real concern for their well-being. It's truly reassuring to be able to rely on someone trustworthy. Thank you for everything you do!
I highly recommend this grooming salon ☺️

Good evening Léa, who are you?
I don't know you and I haven't seen a Léa recently. There are two salons on the same street; you must have gone to the wrong one. Furthermore, giving a one-star rating without explanation is a bit odd, you see!

I took my dog ​​to Aude for grooming, and I'm absolutely delighted with the result. She's very professional and gentle with animals, which was very reassuring. My dog ​​came out perfectly clean and well-groomed, and she seemed very happy. I highly recommend this groomer to all pet owners!
The best! I've been going there for two years for my little Oreo; she takes great care of him and is very gentle with animals. I highly recommend it! 🤍 …
She is so nice and the dog was happy and beautiful

My second visit to Au Luxe Canin and just as satisfied as before. Aude is very busy, yet she takes the time to groom your dog with love, passion, and patience. Rocky loves coming, and it's always a pleasure to pick him up looking beautiful, happy, and clean. See you soon!
I regularly and confidently entrust my little Yorkshire to Aude and always leave satisfied. Very nice cut, done with patience, kindness and expertise. A big thank you.

An excellent experience for my Pomeranian, Baloo! The groomer was very attentive, taking the time to explain everything and give me valuable advice. I really saw the difference compared to another groomer: his coat is much silkier and the care he received is incomparable. Her professionalism and expertise make all the difference. I highly recommend her!

First grooming visit for our 5-year-old Pomeranian. After doing some research, we chose Au Luxe Canin!

Thank you, Aude, for everything: the communication, the explanations of the treatments, and the different grooming options for our dog.
She left looking beautiful, soft, and with a great trim.
We can't wait to go back! See you soon!
Always very satisfied with our visits with Wizzi. Aude is attentive, patient, and the result is always impeccable. I've been going there for years and highly recommend it. Thank you :)
Aude is very friendly and professional, always very kind to my little boy, excellent work!
Rubis, our Westie, loves going to Aude's for grooming; he comes out looking better every time... she's a true pro.

I recently moved to Paris and didn't know of a grooming salon. I was very happy with Aude, and she takes great care of my dog, Logan. When I take Logan to the salon, he always looks handsome and smells wonderful. I highly recommend Aude and Au Luxe Canin.
Incredible service, I recommend it 100%!

I’ve been going to au luxe canin for almost a year and I’m very happy not only with the grooming but with how friendly and caring the groomer is with my dog! My dog loves going there. I highly recommend this place.
I highly recommend this salon. Aude is a virtuoso groomer and truly knows how to handle our furry friends. Our little Malou always looks gorgeous when she comes back from Luxe Canin.

I am absolutely delighted with Aude's work. She took such gentle and patient care of my Spitz puppy for his first grooming session. From the moment we arrived, she immediately put him at ease with her kindness and professionalism. She took the time to ask me about my expectations and gave me lots of advice on training and grooming.
He came out looking beautiful, well-groomed, and relaxed. You can tell she loves animals and knows how to make them feel comfortable. I was a little apprehensive about this first grooming session, but thanks to Aude, everything went perfectly. I highly recommend her services to all owners looking for a passionate, caring, and skilled groomer. Thank you again, Aude; I recommend her without hesitation!
The animal has never looked so beautiful.
Loved my experience here. Groomer is friendly and she does a great job. My little Munchie looks so fresh and so clean ❤️ Thank you so much! And see you again soon.
My dog ​​doesn't want to go anywhere else. He's found his favorite salon; if he could talk, he'd swear by Aude 🤣 Thank you for existing ☺️ …
Thank you Aude for taking such good care of Sunny, he's gorgeous and so happy thanks to you! ❤️🐶 …

I don't understand your review since I canceled your appointment for medical reasons, as you clearly understood over the phone. Especially since I don't accept dogs with matted fur, and your Coton de Tulear was full of it. You should be ashamed of leaving your dog in such a state; it's animal abuse. I directed you to another salon where you were warned about the serious consequences for your dog's condition, namely a complete shave since the mats were at the roots. You agreed with the manager of the other salon and then gave a one-star rating after your visit to both her and mine. You really need to reconsider your approach. A dog needs to be groomed at home; you don't wait for a disaster to occur before contacting a professional. When you leave a review, it would be best if it were justified with valid reasons, especially since I didn't cancel your appointment over the phone. Now, I advise you to brush your Coton de Tulear. See you soon.
Thank you Aude, as usual my little Yumi is beautiful and sweet as can be ❤️❤️

Top-notch groomer, professional and friendly!

I'm delighted to take my 19-month-old Pomeranian there; he always comes out looking handsome, well-groomed, and with just the right cut.
I highly recommend her.

We've been visiting this place regularly for two years and have always been pleased. She loves animals and is very kind. Amy will miss you, and it's a shame we had to leave. I hope we see each other again. I highly recommend this place. Once you've been there, you won't even look for another place.
Excellent grooming salon. Aude takes perfect care of our four-legged friends. The results are always exceptional. The best salon in Paris.

I left very happy with how Aude took care of my dog; she was very professional and attentive at the same time.
I highly recommend her.

I highly recommend Au Luxe Canin!
Welcoming salon, spotless, and very friendly staff.
5 stars, well deserved!
Thank you!!!
Very professional and patient… thank you for your work.

I took my dog ​​here for the first and last time. My dog ​​is a Pomeranian mix, and we thought, based on the photos, that she would be competent. We agreed that she would only trim and clip him. Somehow, she shaved him completely. This is hardly animal cruelty in a Parisian winter.

You should be ashamed of yourself.

Aude does an exceptional job! Professional, passionate, and attentive, she cares for each dog with gentleness. My Lhasa Apso always comes back looking impeccable and more beautiful than ever after each visit.
I trust her completely and recommend her salon without hesitation!

AU LUXE CANIN is fantastic! Aude, the groomer, is passionate, skilled, and loves her job. My dog ​​is always thrilled after each visit: she's kind, patient, and sometimes even gives him a little treat.

Plus, she's an expert with Pomeranians/Spitz breeds. I highly recommend her!

Go for it without hesitation! Aude is a kind person who deeply loves animals. Sherlock is almost 4 years old and has been lucky enough to have only Aude as his groomer; he always looks magnificent when he leaves. She knows the specific characteristics of Spitz coats very well and knows how to make them look their best (if you're looking for a boogie cut, look elsewhere).

I hope to be able to go there for a long time to come 🥰
The best salon. Exceptionally kind and very professional. My dog ​​Regis loves it.
First grooming session for our puppy! Very satisfied. Professional work done with great care and, above all, excellent taste. I highly recommend!

I would have loved to try this amazing grooming salon, but unfortunately, my 10-kilo Shiba Inu isn't accepted! The manager's reasons: "Ouch, I don't take Shibas anymore," "There's too much work involved with a Shiba, I have back problems"... I think it's more like discrimination against my dog's breed... They should specify that it's a salon only for small breeds like rats, Chihuahuas, and Pomeranians under 5 kilos 🥲
Aude is truly professional and loves dogs. My two Toy Maltipoos were impeccably groomed. I highly recommend her.
Amazing experience.
Aude is the best, the salon was recommended by a friend and I am very satisfied!
Second grooming for our dog Tim, we are delighted. The grooming and care were of very high quality; excellent work by Aude, who is passionate about her profession. She is highly recommended!
I've been taking my bulldog to this salon for several months now, and it's a complete and high-quality service! The prices are reasonable, and the results are impeccable.

First grooming for my dog ​​and I'm so glad I went to Luxe Canin.
The service, grooming, and care were top-notch. Excellent work by Aude – she's passionate about her job and highly recommended! 🌟⭐ …

A very pleasant surprise during a short stay in the Paris region. We dropped off our dog to get a grooming session. We were very happy with the result. The welcome was very warm and the service was excellent. I highly recommend this place. We've saved this address for our next trip to the Paris region. Thank you again!

Top-notch groomer, super professional and friendly!!! I'm so glad I took my Pomeranian there!! I highly recommend her.
Thanks again for everything you did!! We'll be back 🙂 …
Excellent service from someone who loves their job! A big thank you!

Fantastic grooming salon, the best in Paris! Aude is truly professional and very attentive to our furry friends. I highly recommend her after trying several groomers. This is the first time my little Jackson has left so well-groomed and with such a superb cut. It was my first time there, and I will definitely be back. She's a true professional. Thank you, Aude, for grooming Jackson and giving him such a great haircut! He looked unrecognizable afterward—a real joy! Keep up the good work; you'll be very successful. I'll recommend you to my friends. A thousand thanks for your warm welcome and kindness. See you soon!

Wow... I can't believe it! 😍 I dropped off my little baby for her first grooming appointment and everything went perfectly.
She's incredibly kind and reassuring, which is so appreciated.
She really knows her stuff and even gave me great care tips.
I dropped my dog ​​off with a terrible coat and picked her up soft, happy, smelling wonderful, and with a great trim.
I booked another appointment right away!
Thanks again!!
Prince came out looking and feeling great. A very warm welcome; she's so kind and reassuring, and she knows exactly how to take care of our dogs 🐕. Thank you, Aude! …
